## About
Kirkland Autobody is a family owned shop that has stayed at the same location in Kirkland for a long time. We work on both retail and commercial vehicle collisions, and our mission is simple: seamless repairs.
We'd rather do quality over quantity. Reviewers know Jake and Yuri by name, and our customers have given us a 4.9 rating from 93 Google reviews.

## Services
- Free Walk-In Estimates: Stop by and we'll take a look and give you an estimate at no charge.
- Retail and commercial vehicle collisions: We work on collisions for both personal and commercial vehicles.
- Paint: One reviewer came in with scrapes, and Yuri buffed them out and touched up some paint.
- Dents and broken side mirrors: One customer brought in a dent on the passenger side and a broken side mirror, and said the car looks brand new.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need an appointment for an estimate?
A: No. Estimates are walk-in and free, so just come by during business hours.

Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: We work with a majority of the insurance carriers and rental car companies. Give us a call and we can tell you about yours.

Q: Do you work on commercial vehicles?
A: Yes. We work on both retail and commercial vehicle collisions.
